name: Explorornis
isnote: PBDB places it in Alexornithidae, a family not used here; known from fragments.
sum: Turonian bird from the Bissekty Formation of Uzbekistan, a small enantiornithine-like form.
wsnote: About 15–20 cm, E. walkeri probably over 25 cm (Wikipedia revision cited).
holotype: Fragmentary bones from the Bissekty Formation (number in Panteleyev 1998).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Panteleyev 1998

sources.text: A. V. Panteleyev. 1998. [New species of enantiornithines (Aves: Enantiornithes) from the Upper Cretaceous of central Kyzylkum]. Russkii Ornitologicheskii Zhurnal Ekspress Vypusk 35:3-15
